description: ECHO: Retrieve one civil enforcement case by case number, with the facilities, defendants, and settlements behind it. Returns the case's category, enforcement type, status, lead agency, relief sought, outcome, court and DOJ docket numbers, summary, and penalty, cost-recovery, compliance-action, and SEP totals; the laws and sections cited; the facilities the case names, one per EPA Registry ID, with address, NAICS and SIC codes, and the program IDs the case links (pass a registryId to epa_echo_get_facility for its compliance profile); defendants; pollutants; milestones; and every enforcement conclusion (order, consent decree, or other settlement) with its facilities, dates, penalties and costs, complying actions, pollutant reductions, and Supplemental Environmental Projects. Take the case number from epa_echo_search_violations or from a formal action's caseId in epa_echo_get_facility. Civil cases only: a criminal CR_ case number fails before any request.

case_id.description: Civil enforcement case number: a caseId from epa_echo_search_violations (e.g. "03-2014-7010", "WA-100446") or a formal action's caseId from epa_echo_get_facility (e.g. "WAPSCAF000000000000000416"). Criminal case numbers ("CR_1270") are rejected.

name: epa_echo_get_case

caseCategoryCode.description: Case category code: "JDC" civil judicial, "AFR" administrative formal

caseId.description: Case number, as ECHO records it

caseName.description: Case name; absent when ECHO records none

complianceActionCostInDollars.description: Estimated cost of the injunctive relief and other actions required to return to compliance, in dollars

costRecoveryInDollars.description: Response costs the parties agreed or were ordered to repay, in dollars — the outcome of a CERCLA cost-recovery case

courtDocketNumber.description: The court's or region's docket number, e.g. "18-195"

defendants.description: Defendants the case names; empty when ECHO records none, as on many state cases

namedInComplaint.description: True when the complaint names the defendant

namedInSettlement.description: True when a settlement names the defendant

dojDocketNumber.description: Department of Justice docket number, e.g. "90-11-3-06663/2"

enforcementConclusions.description: Enforcement conclusions in ECHO's order; fields ECHO leaves empty are absent

items.description: One order, consent decree, or other settlement that concluded part of the case

closedDate.description: Date the enforcement action was closed (MM/DD/YYYY)

complianceActionCostInDollars.description: Estimated cost of this conclusion's compliance actions, in dollars

complyingActions.description: Actions the conclusion requires to return to compliance

conclusionNumber.description: The conclusion's number within the case

costRecoveryInDollars.description: Response costs this conclusion recovers, in dollars

penaltyAssessedInDollars.description: Federal penalty this conclusion assesses, in dollars

media.description: Medium the reduction is in, e.g. "Land", "Soil"

source.description: Whether a complying action or a SEP achieves the reduction

registryIds.description: Registry IDs of the facilities the conclusion covers

stateLocalPenaltyInDollars.description: State or local penalty this conclusion assesses, in dollars

supplementalProjectCostInDollars.description: Cost of this conclusion's Supplemental Environmental Projects, in dollars

supplementalProjects.description: Supplemental Environmental Projects (SEPs) the conclusion requires

description.description: SEP category, e.g. "Emergency Planning and Preparedness"

text.description: The project as the settlement describes it

type.description: Kind of conclusion, e.g. "Consent Decree or Court Order Resolving a Civil Judicial Action", "State/Local Action"

enforcementOutcome.description: How the case was resolved, e.g. "Final Order No Penalty"

enforcementType.description: Kind of enforcement action, e.g. "Administrative Order", "Bankruptcy", "CERCLA 120E Federal Facility Agreement (FFA)"

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `criminal_case`: case_id is a criminal case number (CR_ prefix), which ECHO's civil case report rejects. `case_not_found`: ECHO has no civil case report for the case number. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facilities.description: Facilities the case names, one per Registry ID in ECHO's order; a case can span several states

naicsCodes.description: NAICS codes the case records for the facility, each once, in ECHO's order

noLongerExists.description: True when FRS marks the facility as no longer existing

programIds.description: Program-system IDs the case links to the facility, in ECHO's order

items.description: One program ID the case links to the facility

id.description: Program ID, e.g. an NPDES permit or SEMS site ID

system.description: Program system the ID belongs to, e.g. "ICIS", "SEMS", "AIR"

registryId.description: EPA FRS Registry ID — pass it as registry_id to epa_echo_get_facility for the compliance profile. Absent on a facility row ECHO records without one.

sicCodes.description: SIC codes the case records for the facility, each once, in ECHO's order

lawsAndSections.description: Statutes and sections the case cites

programs.description: Programs the sections fall under, e.g. "Cost Recovery/Financial"

sections.description: Sections cited, comma-separated, e.g. "107A: Cost Recovery"

penaltyAssessedInDollars.description: Federal penalty assessed across the case, in dollars

penaltyCollectedInDollars.description: Penalty ECHO records as collected, in dollars

casNumber.description: Chemical Abstracts Service number, without hyphens (e.g. "7440382")

reliefSought.description: Relief the case seeks, e.g. "Cost Recovery"; absent when ECHO records none

stateLocalPenaltyInDollars.description: State or local penalty assessed across the case, in dollars

summary.description: Case summary as EPA wrote it

supplementalProjectCostInDollars.description: Cost of the Supplemental Environmental Projects agreed, in dollars

violations.description: Violation description ECHO records, e.g. "Oil Spill Violation Under CWA/OPA"

title: Get EPA Enforcement Case
